mdcalc_rules: Points = age in years; female -10; nursing home +10; neoplastic disease +30; liver disease +20; CHF +10; cerebrovascular disease +10; renal disease +10; altered mental status +20; RR >=30 +20; SBP <90 +20; temp <35C or >39.9C (Step-1 text says >=40C) +15; pulse >=125 +10; pH <7.35 +30; BUN >=30 mg/dL (>=11 mmol/L) +20; Na <130 mmol/L +20; glucose >=250 mg/dL (>=14 mmol/L) +10; Hct <30% +10; PaO2 <60 mmHg (<8 kPa) +10; pleural effusion +10. Classes: <=70, 71-90, 91-130, >130. MDCalc page lists PaO2 only (no SaO2 <90% option, which Fine 1997 includes) and gives no definitions for comorbidities.

code_vs_mdcalc.issue: No issue affecting scoring: all thresholds/points match MDCalc (temp uses >39.9 like MDCalc's input table; HR>=125, RR>=30, SBP<90, pH<7.35, BUN>=30 mg/dL, Na<130, glucose>=250 mg/dL, Hct<30, PaO2<60 mmHg/<8 kPa). Code reproduces every stored answer from stored inputs.

Glucose/BUN in mmol/L are converted with the molar mass (250 mg/dL = 13.88 mmol/L; 30 mg/dL BUN = 10.71 mmol/L), but MDCalc's SI cutoffs are >=14 mmol/L and >=11 mmol/L. This only matters for glucose 13.88-13.99 or BUN 10.71-10.99 mmol/L. No row falls in these ranges (one-shot glucose 13.21 mmol/L is below both).
Oxygen criterion accepts PaO2 only (mm Hg/kPa); no SpO2/SaO2 <90% path (Fine 1997) and code crashes if partial_pressure_oxygen is missing. Every row has a PaO2.
Vitals and labs (HR, temp, pH, RR, SBP, BUN, Na, glucose, Hct) have no absent-equals-normal default; a missing key raises KeyError. All rows store every one of them.

dataset_conventions: A criterion the note does not mention is absent/normal; for 'absence' criteria the criterion is met.
Values are taken at the time point the question names (admission/initial presentation before treatment) unless the question says otherwise.
GCS: a component documented as not testable gets full points.

Keep as close to v1.0 as possible; change only genuine mistakes (wrong input vs note, wrong label, unit/typo errors, contradictions). Prefer the smallest fix: correct an input if the note is clear; edit the note minimally if the note itself is ambiguous or contradictory.
